name: Advanced Vocab 08 - IELTS: Environment, Health & Economy

cards.definition: The variety of plant and animal life in an area (जैव विविधता)
cards.exampleSentence: Deforestation threatens biodiversity.

cards.definition: A community of living things and their environment (पारिस्थितिकी तंत्र)
cards.exampleSentence: Coral reefs are fragile ecosystems.

cards.definition: The natural home of an animal or plant (प्राकृतिक आवास)
cards.exampleSentence: Urban growth destroys wildlife habitats.

cards.definition: A species at risk of extinction (विलुप्तप्राय प्रजाति)
cards.exampleSentence: Tigers are an endangered species.

cards.definition: The complete disappearance of a species (विलुप्ति)
cards.exampleSentence: Hunting drove several species to extinction.

cards.definition: Protection of nature and natural resources (संरक्षण)
cards.exampleSentence: Wildlife conservation requires community support.

cards.definition: Keeping something in its original state (संरक्षण)
cards.exampleSentence: The preservation of forests protects water supplies.

cards.definition: Clearing of forests on a large scale (वनों की कटाई)
cards.exampleSentence: Deforestation increases carbon emissions.

cards.definition: Planting trees on land previously without forest (नए वन लगाना)
cards.exampleSentence: Afforestation helps restore soil quality.

cards.definition: The total greenhouse gases caused by an activity or person (कार्बन उत्सर्जन का प्रभाव)
cards.exampleSentence: Flying greatly increases an individual's carbon footprint.

cards.definition: A gas that traps heat in the atmosphere (ग्रीनहाउस गैस)
cards.exampleSentence: Methane is a powerful greenhouse gas.

cards.definition: Gases released into the air (उत्सर्जन)
cards.exampleSentence: Factories must reduce emissions.

cards.definition: Coal, oil and gas formed from ancient organisms (जीवाश्म ईंधन)
cards.exampleSentence: Fossil fuels remain the main source of energy.

cards.definition: Energy from sources that replenish naturally (नवीकरणीय ऊर्जा)
cards.exampleSentence: Renewable energy is now cheaper than coal in many places.

cards.definition: Energy obtained from the sun (सौर ऊर्जा)
cards.exampleSentence: Solar power is booming in rural India.

cards.definition: A machine that converts wind into electricity (पवन टरबाइन)
cards.exampleSentence: Offshore wind turbines generate large amounts of power.

cards.definition: Having no net release of carbon dioxide (कार्बन-तटस्थ)
cards.exampleSentence: The city aims to be carbon neutral by 2040.

cards.definition: Balancing emitted and removed greenhouse gases (शुद्ध शून्य उत्सर्जन)
cards.exampleSentence: Many countries pledged to reach net zero by 2050.

cards.definition: The gradual rise of Earth's temperature (वैश्विक तापमान वृद्धि)
cards.exampleSentence: Global warming is melting polar ice.

cards.definition: Long-term shifts in temperatures and weather patterns (जलवायु परिवर्तन)
cards.exampleSentence: Climate change increases the frequency of floods.

cards.definition: The increase in the average level of the oceans (समुद्र स्तर में वृद्धि)
cards.exampleSentence: Sea level rise threatens coastal cities.

cards.definition: Severe and unusual weather events (चरम मौसम)
cards.exampleSentence: Extreme weather is becoming more common.

cards.definition: A long period of abnormally low rainfall (सूखा)
cards.exampleSentence: A prolonged drought devastated crops.

cards.definition: Overflow of water onto normally dry land (बाढ़)
cards.exampleSentence: Heavy rains caused severe flooding.

cards.definition: A long period of unusually hot weather (लू / भीषण गर्मी)
cards.exampleSentence: The heatwave pushed electricity demand to a record.

cards.definition: The process of fertile land becoming desert (मरुस्थलीकरण)
cards.exampleSentence: Overgrazing contributes to desertification.

cards.definition: The wearing away of topsoil (मिट्टी का कटाव)
cards.exampleSentence: Soil erosion reduces farm productivity.

cards.definition: A shortage of fresh water (पानी की कमी)

cards.definition: Water held underground in soil and rocks (भूजल)

cards.definition: To use up resources so little remains (ख़त्म करते जाना)
cards.exampleSentence: Overfishing has depleted ocean stocks.

cards.definition: To use up completely (पूरी तरह इस्तेमाल कर डालना)
cards.exampleSentence: We risk exhausting natural resources.

cards.definition: To use resources, often unfairly or excessively (दोहन करना)
cards.exampleSentence: Companies exploit forests for timber.

cards.definition: To damage or lower the quality of (बिगाड़ना)
cards.exampleSentence: Pollution degrades water quality.

cards.definition: To make impure by adding a harmful substance (दूषित करना)

cards.definition: A substance that harms the environment (प्रदूषक)

cards.definition: Fog mixed with smoke and pollution (धुंध और धुएँ का मिश्रण)

cards.definition: The cleanliness of the air (हवा की गुणवत्ता)
cards.exampleSentence: Poor air quality causes respiratory disease.

cards.definition: A site where waste is buried (कूड़ा-भराव स्थल)
cards.exampleSentence: Landfills are filling up fast.

cards.definition: Converting waste into reusable material (पुनर्चक्रण)
cards.exampleSentence: Recycling reduces the amount of waste.

cards.definition: Plastic products designed to be used once (एक बार इस्तेमाल होने वाला प्लास्टिक)

cards.definition: Able to decompose naturally (जैव-अपघटनीय)
cards.exampleSentence: Biodegradable packaging reduces waste.

cards.definition: Discarded electronic devices (इलेक्ट्रॉनिक कचरा)

cards.definition: Using resources faster than they can be replaced (अत्यधिक उपभोग)
cards.exampleSentence: Overconsumption drives environmental damage.

cards.definition: The preoccupation with buying goods (उपभोक्तावाद)
cards.exampleSentence: Consumerism encourages wasteful habits.

cards.definition: Development meeting present needs without harming the future (सतत विकास)
cards.exampleSentence: Sustainable development balances growth and nature.

cards.definition: Not harmful to the environment (पर्यावरण के अनुकूल)
cards.exampleSentence: Eco-friendly products are growing in popularity.

cards.definition: Areas of parks and nature in cities (हरित क्षेत्र)
cards.exampleSentence: Green spaces improve mental wellbeing.

cards.definition: Produced without artificial chemicals (जैविक)
cards.exampleSentence: Organic produce is often more expensive.

cards.definition: A chemical used to kill pests (कीटनाशक)

cards.definition: Farming a single crop over a large area (एकल फ़सल खेती)
cards.exampleSentence: Monoculture depletes soil nutrients.

cards.definition: Reliable access to sufficient nutritious food (खाद्य सुरक्षा)
cards.exampleSentence: Climate change threatens food security.

cards.definition: Extreme scarcity of food (अकाल)

cards.definition: Lack of proper nutrition (कुपोषण)

cards.definition: The condition of being very overweight (मोटापा)
cards.exampleSentence: Childhood obesity has risen sharply.

cards.definition: A widespread occurrence of disease in a community (महामारी (स्थानीय))
cards.exampleSentence: Diabetes is becoming an epidemic.

cards.exampleSentence: The pandemic changed how people work.

cards.definition: Resistance to disease (रोग प्रतिरोधक क्षमता)
cards.exampleSentence: Vaccines build immunity.

cards.definition: Giving a vaccine to protect against disease (टीकाकरण)
cards.exampleSentence: Mass vaccination reduced infection rates.

cards.definition: Measures taken to avoid illness (निवारक स्वास्थ्य सेवा)
cards.exampleSentence: Preventive healthcare lowers long-term costs.

cards.definition: Persisting for a long time (दीर्घकालिक)
cards.exampleSentence: Chronic stress harms physical health.

cards.definition: Severe and sudden in onset (तीव्र)

cards.definition: Capable of causing death (जानलेवा)

cards.definition: The state of being comfortable, healthy and happy (कल्याण / स्वास्थ्य)
cards.exampleSentence: Employers should support staff well-being.

cards.definition: A person's psychological and emotional condition (मानसिक स्वास्थ्य)
cards.exampleSentence: Mental health needs the same attention as physical health.

cards.definition: A mark of disgrace associated with something (कलंक की धारणा)

cards.definition: A feeling of worry or unease (चिंता / बेचैनी)

cards.definition: Employees able to cope with stress and change (तनाव झेलने में सक्षम कार्यबल)
cards.exampleSentence: Training builds a resilient workforce.

cards.definition: The health of the population as a whole (जन स्वास्थ्य)

cards.definition: The supply of medical services (स्वास्थ्य सेवाओं की उपलब्धता)

cards.definition: Health services available to all citizens (सार्वभौमिक स्वास्थ्य सेवा)

cards.definition: A list of people waiting for treatment or service (प्रतीक्षा सूची)
cards.exampleSentence: Long waiting lists delay surgery.

cards.definition: Able to be stopped from happening (रोकथाम योग्य)

cards.definition: The way a person lives (जीवनशैली)
cards.exampleSentence: A healthy lifestyle includes exercise and good sleep.

cards.definition: Food containing all necessary nutrients in right proportions (संतुलित आहार)

cards.definition: Food high in calories but low in nutrition (अस्वास्थ्यकर खाना)

cards.definition: Food altered from its natural state (प्रसंस्कृत खाद्य)

cards.definition: A substance needed for growth and health (पोषक तत्व)

cards.definition: Any movement of the body that uses energy (शारीरिक गतिविधि)

cards.definition: A way of living involving little exercise (गतिहीन जीवनशैली)
cards.exampleSentence: A sedentary lifestyle causes back problems.

cards.definition: Facilities for recharging electric vehicles (चार्जिंग की सुविधाएँ)

cards.definition: General knowledge of an issue among people (जन जागरूकता)
cards.exampleSentence: Public awareness campaigns reduced littering.

cards.definition: A movement started by ordinary people (आम लोगों द्वारा शुरू किया गया अभियान)
cards.exampleSentence: A grassroots campaign saved the local forest.

cards.definition: Deterioration of the natural environment (पर्यावरणीय क्षरण)
cards.exampleSentence: Environmental degradation harms public health.

cards.definition: Atmospheric layer that blocks harmful ultraviolet rays (ओज़ोन परत)
cards.exampleSentence: The ozone layer is slowly recovering.

cards.definition: Rain made acidic by pollutants (अम्लीय वर्षा)
cards.exampleSentence: Acid rain damages forests and buildings.

cards.definition: Harmful or annoying levels of noise (ध्वनि प्रदूषण)
cards.exampleSentence: Noise pollution affects sleep and stress.

cards.definition: Excessive artificial light at night (प्रकाश प्रदूषण)
cards.exampleSentence: Light pollution disturbs migrating birds.

cards.definition: Catching fish faster than they can reproduce (अत्यधिक मछली पकड़ना)
cards.exampleSentence: Overfishing is emptying the oceans.

cards.definition: Illegal hunting of wildlife (अवैध शिकार)
cards.exampleSentence: Poaching pushes rhinos towards extinction.

cards.definition: A protected area for animals (वन्यजीव अभयारण्य)
cards.exampleSentence: The sanctuary protects endangered tigers.

cards.definition: A protected natural area (राष्ट्रीय उद्यान)
cards.exampleSentence: Visitors to the national park must follow strict rules.

cards.definition: Aware of and concerned about the environment (पर्यावरण के प्रति जागरूक)
cards.exampleSentence: Eco-conscious consumers prefer sustainable brands.

cards.definition: Aiming to send nothing to landfill (शून्य कचरा)
cards.exampleSentence: Many cafes are going zero waste.

cards.definition: To reuse materials to create better-quality items (पुराने से बेहतर चीज़ बनाना)
cards.exampleSentence: She upcycles old furniture into new designs.

cards.definition: To turn organic waste into fertiliser (जैविक कचरे से खाद बनाना)
cards.exampleSentence: Many households compost kitchen waste.

cards.definition: Replanting trees in cleared areas (दोबारा वन लगाना)
cards.exampleSentence: Reforestation restores habitats and soil.

cards.definition: Restoring land to its natural uncultivated state (भूमि को प्राकृतिक अवस्था में लौटाना)
cards.exampleSentence: Rewilding brought back native species.

cards.definition: A way of earning that doesn't harm resources (टिकाऊ आजीविका)
cards.exampleSentence: Ecotourism provides a sustainable livelihood.

cards.definition: A person displaced by climate effects (जलवायु शरणार्थी)
cards.exampleSentence: Rising seas will create millions of climate refugees.

cards.definition: A sudden destructive natural event (प्राकृतिक आपदा)
cards.exampleSentence: Early warning systems save lives in natural disasters.

cards.definition: Aid given after a disaster (आपदा राहत)
cards.exampleSentence: Disaster relief reached the flooded villages quickly.

cards.definition: The using up of natural resources (संसाधनों का ह्रास)
cards.exampleSentence: Resource depletion threatens future generations.
